metadata.nutritionBasis: Current v2 records use explicit nutrition_data_per values 100g or100ml only. Older search-index records retain unknown 100g-or-100ml basis. Package size is never used to infer nutrition basis.
metadata.searchIndexAgeNote: Records identify their source API and source last-modified date. Current v2 records are preferred where retrieved; older Search-a-licious records have source dates up to2024-12. Retrieval date is not source freshness.
metadata.sourceQuality: Community reference; no manually verified HK labels and no complete allergy statements added in this batch
limitations: No claims that OFF country tags prove current HK availability or Hong Kong formulation
No prices or purchase channels invented for standalone OFF products
Current v2 source data-quality-error tags are applied as holds; older search-index responses omit those tags, so only transparent arithmetic checks are possible for older entries.
Public matches use independent name, brand and quantity checks; supplementary CC barcode mapping remains internal
